title: 第005章 66倍返还极品观想法原地起飞的开始第006章 灵魂蜕变极品震魂符越阶杀敌的底牌
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
乱葬岗中，
苏辰弯腰将两人身上的东西搜了一遍，连同尸体一并收进了山海灵虚界。
下一刻，尸栏那片阴地里，系统提示声随之响起。
【检测到可绑定尸类生灵。】
【白色品质尸体*2。】
【是否进行绑定？】
苏辰目光一扫，落在那具胖墩邪修身上。
这人个头不高，肚子滚圆，脸上横肉还没散尽，尸体落在黑土上时，周身残留的邪气比那瘦高个更重些。
“就他吧——”
苏辰抬手一点，直接选了那具胖尸。
【绑定成功。】
话音刚落，尸栏里的景象立刻又变了。
原本只是黑土翻潮、棺材半埋的地面，此刻缓缓鼓起一块长条土台。
土台中央，泥土自动往两边分开，一口灰黑色的旧棺材慢慢升了起来。
棺身不大，棺盖边缘钉着几枚暗黄铜钉，木头表面布满水痕和尸斑，像是埋在地底许多年后才刚被挖出来。
“咔......”
棺盖轻轻滑开一道缝。
胖邪修的尸体被一股无形力量托起，平平落进棺中。
棺底的黑土也随之变化，颜色更深，且更加湿润，甚至还隐隐泛着一层灰白尸气，像是专门拿来养尸的阴土。
苏辰站在棺前，看着那张胖脸，眉头却皱了起来。

尸栏是有了。
尸体也绑进去了。
可这玩意儿刚死没多久，离起尸、成行尸、化僵尸还早得很。
若只是干躺着，怕是十天半月都不见得能有反应。
“这东西......该喂什么？”
苏辰心里刚冒出这念头，胖邪修的面板便自动弹了出来。
【饲养物：无名尸体】
【品质：白色】
【所属栏位：尸】
【进化度：0%】
【当前状态：初死，尸气未凝】
【适宜投喂：血液、血肉精华、煞气、邪气、阴属性丹药......】
......
苏辰看完，眼神立刻亮了亮。
阴属性丹药？
这两个邪修身上应该有！
他蹲下身，开始翻找两具尸体身上的口袋。
第一个摸出来的是几个丹药瓶，瓶身粗糙，塞子一拔开，里头便飘出一股苦腥气。
再往下翻，是几张黑色符篆，符纸发脆，边缘还沾着暗红指印。
最后则是一个巴掌大小的鬼袋，袋口系着灰绳，里头阴气鼓荡，隐约还有呜呜哭声。
content_en:
In mass graves,
Su Chen bent down and searched the two people's belongings, and took the bodies together into the Shanhai Lingxu Realm.
The next moment, in the underworld of the corpse column, a system prompt sounded.
[It has been detected that zombie creatures can be bound. 】
[White quality corpse*2. 】
【Do you want to bind? 】
Su Chen glanced at the fat evil cultivator.
This man was not tall, with a round belly, and the flesh on his face had not yet disappeared. When the body fell on the black soil, the evil spirit remaining around him was heavier than that of the tall and thin man.
"Just him——"
Su Chen raised his hand and directly selected the fat corpse.
[Binding successful. 】
As soon as he finished speaking, the scene in the corpse column immediately changed again.
The ground that was originally just black soil with the coffin half-buried now slowly bulged out into a long platform of earth.
In the center of the earth platform, the earth automatically separated to both sides, and an old gray-black coffin slowly rose up.
The coffin was not big, and there were a few dark brass nails hammered into the edge of the coffin lid. The surface of the wood was covered with water marks and body spots, as if it had been dug up after being buried underground for many years.
"Click..."
The coffin lid gently slid open a crack.
The body of the fat evil cultivator was lifted up by an invisible force and fell flatly into the coffin.
The black soil at the bottom of the coffin also changed accordingly, becoming darker in color and more moist, and even had a faint layer of gray-white corpse aura, like the Yin soil specially used to raise corpses.
Su Chen stood in front of the coffin, looking at the fat face, but his brows furrowed.
There is a corpse corral.
The body was also tied in.
But this thing just died not long ago, and it is still very early for it to rise from the corpse, become a walking corpse, or turn into a zombie.
If you just lie down, you may not be able to react for ten days and a half.
"What...should I feed this thing?"
As soon as this idea came to Su Chen's mind, Fat Xiexiu's panel popped up automatically.
[Feed: Unnamed Corpse]
[Quality: White]
[Official column: Corpse]
[Evolution degree: 0%]
[Current status: First dead, corpse energy has not yet condensed]
[Suitable for feeding: blood, flesh and blood essence, evil spirits, evil spirits, Yin attribute elixirs...]
...
After Su Chen read it, his eyes immediately lit up.
Yin-type elixir?
These two evil cultivators should have it!
He knelt down and began to rummage through the pockets of the two corpses.
The first thing I took out were several pill bottles. The bottles were rough, and as soon as the stoppers were pulled out, a bitter smell wafted out of them.
Flipping further down, there are several black talisman seals. The talisman paper is brittle and there are dark red fingerprints on the edges.
Finally, there was a palm-sized ghost bag with a gray rope tied around the mouth. Yin energy was surging inside, and there was a faint sound of whimpering.
